scope: Data subjects whose personal data is processed in Seychelles
applies_to: Public and private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Lawful processing and data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure); breach notification to the Commission within 72 hours (s. 44 in the Bill); administrative fines by the Commission
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data (includes genetic and health data)
penalties_range: Administrative fines and offences under Part VIII (unlawful disclosure, obstruction); amounts not found (unconfirmed)
exemptions: Criminal investigation and national security by relevant authorities; purely personal processing by a natural person (exemptions provision s. 4)
genetic_data: Genetic data is listed as sensitive personal data (Part IV, s. 22 in the enacted Act)
notes: Replaced the never-implemented Data Protection Act 2003. 18-month transition from 22 Dec 2023 (to about June 2025) for controllers to comply. Enactment date is presidential assent 19 Dec 2023; published in Gazette 22 Dec 2023.
